description:
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Mardu Warshrieker with haste.
The Mardu Warshrieker token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Mardu Warshrieker trigger, adding {R}{W}{B}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
